claim: Local hyperthermia therapy (LHT) at 41°C induces thermogenesis in mouse and human adipocytes.

source_trace.quote: Strikingly, compared with pretreatment, LHT on iWAT resulted in significantly enhanced heat production in iWAT compared with Sham iWAT of the same mouse (Figure 1D). Molecular analysis in iWAT showed increased mRNA levels of brown gene programs, as well as increased UCP1 protein levels in LHT group (Figures 1E and 1F).

claim: HSF1 binds to the HSE region of the A2b1 promoter and this binding is enhanced upon hyperthermia treatment.

source_trace.quote: ChIP-seq analysis revealed specific enrichment of HSF1 binding on the A2b1 promoter region, while in silico prediction revealed a classic heat-shock-factor-binding element (HSE) within this region... Subsequent ChIP assay confirmed specific HSF1 binding on the predicted HSE region of A2b1 promoter... Importantly, this HSF1 binding is largely enhanced upon HT.

measurement.measured_variable: HSF1 binding enrichment on A2b1 promoter

claim: Overexpression of active HSF1 induces A2b1 transcriptional activation via the HSE site on the A2b1 promoter.

source_trace.quote: As shown in luciferase assay, overexpression of active form HSF1 significantly induced A2b1 transcriptional activation, while this activation was lost by mutating the HSE site (mHSE) on the A2b1 promoter.

measurement.measured_value: induced by active HSF1, lost with HSE mutation

claim: Hyperthermia (HT) in vitro, local hyperthermia (LHT) in vivo, and AAV Active HSF1 in mice iWAT all enhance A2b1 expression.

structured_fields.intervention: hyperthermia (HT), local hyperthermia (LHT), AAV Active HSF1

experimental_model.model_name: C3H10T1/2-derived beige adipocytes, immortalized beige adipocytes, mice iWAT
experimental_model.tissue_or_cell_type: beige adipocyte, inguinal white adipose tissue (iWAT)

source_trace.quote: Echoing the results of luciferase analysis, in vitro manipulation using hyperthermia on beige adipocytes, in vivo manipulations via LHT or AAV Active HSF1 in mice iWAT, all resulted in enhanced A2b1 expression.

claim: HSF1 deficiency abrogates A2b1 expression both in vitro and in vivo.

experimental_model.model_name: beige adipocytes, HSF1 FKO mice iWAT
experimental_model.tissue_or_cell_type: beige adipocyte, inguinal white adipose tissue (iWAT)

source_trace.quote: while HSF1 deficiency abrogated A2b1 expression both in vitro and in vivo, as demonstrated using siHSF1 delivery into beige adipocytes or iWAT of HSF1 FKO mice.

claim: A2b1 levels are increased in iWAT under conditions that promote white fat browning (CL316,243 treatment and cold stimulation) and decreased under conditions that suppress beige fat function (HFD, genetic obesity, aging, thermoneutrality).

structured_fields.upstream_trigger: CL316,243, cold stimulation, HFD, genetic obesity, aging, thermoneutrality

source_trace.quote: A2b1 showed increased expressions in iWAT in conditions that promoting white fat browning, including CL316,243 treatment and cold stimulation, while conversely, A2b1 was downregulated in iWAT in scenarios that suppressing beige fat function, i.e., diet- (HFD) or genetic-(ob/ob) induced obese mice, aging mice, as well as mice under thermoneutral environment.

measurement.measured_value: increased or decreased depending on condition

claim: A2b1 mRNA levels correlate closely with Pgc1a and Ucp1 mRNA levels in mouse iWAT.

source_trace.quote: Furthermore, we found that there is a close correlation between A2b1 mRNA levels with Pgc1a and Ucp1 mRNA levels, respectively, in mice iWAT.

measurement.measured_variable: correlation between A2b1, Pgc1a, and Ucp1 mRNA levels

claim: A2B1 knockdown decreases brown fat gene programs in beige adipocytes.

source_trace.quote: Functionally, A2B1 knockdown (siA2B1) decreased brown fat gene programs in beige adipocytes.

source_trace.quote: More importantly, HT-induced enhancement in Pgc1a and Ucp1 expressions are at least partially dependent on A2B1.

claim: Fat-specific A2B1 overexpression in mouse iWAT decreases body weight, fat mass, and adipocyte size, increases oxygen consumption, enhances cold tolerance, and improves insulin sensitivity and hepatic steatosis under HFD.

structured_fields.effect_size_reported: significant decrease in body weights, fat mass, and adipose tissue weights with smaller adipocyte sizes; increased oxygen consumption; enhanced resistance to cold challenge; improved insulin sensitivity and hepatic steatosis
structured_fields.thermogenic_marker: oxygen consumption, cold tolerance, brown gene programs, PGC1 and UCP1 protein levels

experimental_model.model_name: C57BL/6 mice with AAV A2B1 in iWAT

source_trace.quote: When subjected to HFD, mice with fat-A2B1 overexpression showed significant decrease in body weights, fat mass, and adipose tissue weights with smaller adipocyte sizes. They also featured increased oxygen consumption, enhanced resistance to cold challenge, as well as improved insulin sensitivity and hepatic steatosis.

measurement.measured_variable: body weight, fat mass, oxygen consumption, cold tolerance, insulin sensitivity, hepatic steatosis

claim: LHT induces beige fat activation via the HSF1-A2B1 transcriptional axis as a strategy against obesity.

source_trace.quote: The major finding of this work signifies LHT as a promising strategy against obesity by inducing beige fat activation via the HSF1-A2B1 transcriptional axis.

claim: ChIP-seq was performed using SimpleChIP Plus Enzymatic Chromatin IP Kit with anti-HSF1 antibody in beige adipocytes.

raw_entities.raw_name: SimpleChIP Plus Enzymatic Chromatin IP Kit

source_trace.quote: For ChIP-seq, ChIP assays were first performed using a SimpleChIP Plus Enzymatic Chromatin IP Kit (CST, 9003) according to manufacturer’s instructions. In brief, differentiated C3H10T1/2-derived beige adipocytes or immortalized beige adipocytes were cross-linked by 1% formaldehyde for 10 min and stopped by glycine. The extracted chromatin was digested and fragmented into 200 to 1000 bp, which was then immunoprecipitated by ChIP grade antibodies anti-HSF1 (CST, 4356S) or normal IgG (CST, 2729) using Magnetic Beads.

claim: RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) assay was performed with HNRNPA2B1 antibody in beige and brown adipocytes.

raw_entities.raw_name: Magna RIP RNA-Binding Protein Immunoprecipitation Kit

source_trace.quote: RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) assay was performed with Magna RIP RNA-Binding Protein Immunoprecipitation Kit (Millipore 17-700) according to manufacturer’s instructions. Briefly, fully differentiated immortalized beige or brown adipocytes were washed with ice-cold PBS and resuspended in RIPA lysis buffer (containing RNase inhibitor, Millipore, CS203219). The extract was pre cleared with Sepharose beads and subjected to immunoprecipitation with HNRNPA2B1 antibody (Abcam, ab31645).

claim: Luciferase reporter assay was performed in HEK293T cells using dual luciferase reporter assay kit.

source_trace.quote: HEK293T cells (ATCC) were transfected with indicated plasmids and luciferase reporter together with Renilla luciferase control re porter by EZ-Trans transfection reagent. Cells were collected with passive lysis buffer (Promega, E1960) and luciferase assays were performed using a dual luciferase reporter assay kit (Promega, E1960)

claim: Histological analysis of adipose and liver tissues was performed using H&E staining and adipocyte size quantification by ImageJ.

source_trace.quote: Dissected adipose and liver tissues were fixed in 10% neutral buffered formalin (Sigma-Aldrich, HT501128-4L) and embedded in paraffin. 5 m tissue sections were stained with Hematoxylin and eosin (Beyotime, C0105S) according to manufacturer’s instructions The images were acquired by optical microscope (Nikon) using a 20x objective. Adipocyte sizes were quantified by ImageJ

claim: PDA-PEG hydrogel was prepared via oxidative polymerization of dopamine and mixing with 4-arm-PEG-SH.

source_trace.quote: The PDA-PEG hydrogel (PDA) was prepared as previously reported (Wang et al., 2017). Briefly, PDA nanoparticles were prepared via a spontaneous oxidative polymerization of dopamine under alkaline condition. Subsequently, 0.5 mL PDA nanoparticles (50 mg/mL and 0.5 mL 4-arm-PEG-SH (100 mg/mL) both in aqueous solution were mixed and blended on a Vortex mixer for 5 m.

claim: siRNA transfection was performed in differentiated adipocytes using Lipofectamine2000.

source_trace.quote: siRNA was designed and synthesized by GenePharma (Shanghai, China). siRNA was transfected into differentiated adipocytes using Lipofectamine2000 Transfection Reagent (Thermo Fisher, 11668030) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. The gene expression analysis was determined by RT-qPCR after 48 h.

claim: RNA stability assay was performed using actinomycin D treatment and mRNA half-life calculation in beige adipocytes.

structured_fields.method_name: RNA stability assay with actinomycin D

source_trace.quote: Differentiated immortalized beige adipocytes were transfected with siNC or siRNA against Hnrnpa2b1 or adenovirus mediated Hnrnpa2b1 overexpression (Hanbio biotechnology, Shanghai, China) for two days. Cells were treated with 5 g/ml actinomycin D (Sigma-Aldrich, SBR00013) and harvested at indicated time points. The total RNA was isolated and analyzed by RT-gPCR. The degradation rate of mRNA K_d was estimated by: ln(C_t/C_0) = -K_d t, where t is the time as actinomycin D treatment for transcription inhibition. C is the mRNA concentration. The mRNA half-life tan2 is calculated by: t_1/2 = ln2/K_d
